findings.quote: His mother crossed the yard in three strides and pulled him against her. One hand went into his hair the way it did when he was small.
findings.claim: Beat 3 is the answer to his telling and here it happens before he has told them anything.
findings.fix: Keep the reflex, save the embrace for after.

findings.quote: And they did. They had all of it, now. The sun was fully up, and he was home, and there was time.
findings.claim: The chapter carries on past the required final image and closes on a summary about time.
findings.fix: End on her hand in his hair and the father s nod.

iterations.notes: 10 - 1 for beat 3 out of order. All four elements of beat 2 delivered. The critic also observed in notes that the chapter does not end on the outline s image but carries two exchanges past it; the orchestrator raised that as a second finding on the sheet.

both resolved. Beat 3 now sits after the telling - the arm grip on arrival is a reflex, and the hand in the hair is the pull-close, now the chapter s last line. The critic judged the ending delivered with the nod immediately preceding it.
